verdict.rationale: Statsig is an analytics and experimentation SaaS that ingests user and event data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion requests, or data purge controls. Items about SSO/SCIM, event logging, and Warehouse Native are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
